events.title: Hotfix is Live: Graphics Setting
events.summary: The hotfix is now live. Graphics auto-detection now works correctly and sets the right preset for your hardware, so players on lower-end PCs should no longer be stuck on Epic settings.If you changed your settings manually or still see low FPS, check your graphics settings: \. Pick the preset that works best for your PC, or reset it to auto-detect.Keep the reports coming! They really help us out.

events.title: Known Issue: Graphics Setting
events.summary: Thank you for your feedback!We're aware that graphics auto-detection isn't working correctly right now. It sets many players to Epic settings even on lower-end hardware, which causes low FPS and performance issues. We're working on a fix, and a hotfix is coming soon. In the meantime, we recommend setting your graphics manually: \. We've also seen your feedback about FOV and passed it on to the dev team. Keep the reports coming! They really help us out.
